name: 66935 · Belleville, KS
findings: ZIP 66935 (Belleville) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66935 (Belleville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
